name: Tameeni Insurance
verdict: Tameeni is the digital insurance brand of Rasan Information Technology, a Saudi fintech listed on the Saudi Exchange; the CMA prospectus describes Tameeni Company as a wholly-owned group subsidiary. No state or state fund is in the chain. Nothing found.
note: Rating note: ownership chain stops at Rasan Information Technology (listed on the Saudi Exchange, Tadawul 8313); no state stake or board seat identified in the sources opened, and no human-rights finding against the company → none.
